attBesluta.text: Awesome set works great. Well worth the price. Magnetic feature awesome
Have drill, will travel... i am Very happy with this set I use it for everything I recommend everyone should have this set
Excellent quality. Great assortment of sizes. Used them the very first day they arrived. Nice heavy case, I love the product.
This is a great set for any homeowner. I really like the fact that it is magnetic. It also comes with a solid storage case. I highly recommend this set!!!!
Ottimo oggetto, fabbricazione curata, robusto e di facile utilizzo. come da descrizione.
Simple to set up under my bench grinder..Easy to create fresh sharp angles on my chisels and plane blades

This Jig is awesume. Took me about 3 hours to figure out and make a plywood plate but it's well worth the time. The anxiety of holding plane blades and chisels by hand is in the past. It's actually fun now as I get a perfectly consistant slightly convex bevel in minutes and without overheating. I'll finish the blade with a honing guide...

Aluminum I think, nice and well put together. I liked it enough that I got a second one. The carrier that comes with it has a little play in the slot but I fixed it with painters tape as permanent shim and it actually glides better. Good price too.
Nice fixture for 6” grinders. I bought an 8” grinder and this is a little short. With a little modification it works fine.
I was using it to grind a damaged handplane iron. It works pretty well although the movable tool that grips the object could be better (it slides out too easily and it's hard to make it hold parts)
Hatte Probleme damit die aber sehr gut gelößt wurden.Bin sehr zufrieden über schnelle und direkte Hilfe.Freue mich schon auf den nächsten Einkauf bei ihnen.
Bien emballé dans un coffre en bois, facile a monter Simple d utilisation avec la pompe hydraulique/pneumatique La hauteur du tablier peut se régler sans forcer grâce au treuil a câble.
Tolles Gerät, gefällt mir sehr, aber die Schrauben zum zusammensetzen haben gefehlt!

The line sets are good quality. It would be nice if they came with a small plastic tube bender. Especially for the tubes 1/2" and bigger. Kinked one of the tubes and had to add a flared elbow to make the bend
